projects.title: Paper Trader Android App
projects.description:
The app can be found here: 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mine.stocksimulator

Created a stock simulator that allows users to keep a portfolio by buying and selling stocks, as well as keep a watch list of stocks that seem the most promising.

Tools utilized were SQLite to help keep track of prices and returns and Okhttp to make requests to Markit On Demand API.
